column1: 5.5.4.5.12 BITE – Update ES Auto BITE Reference Data. User shall login into SCD
application in ‘Online Mode’ and SCD Main Window shall be displayed to access this GUI.
User shall click on ‘BITE->Update ES Auto BITE Reference Data’ menu item from ‘System’
menu and a GUI (as shown in Figure-5.279) shall be displayed to update the BITE data in
SCD application. The GUI shall retain the previous BITE data selected & applied by user.
